title: Wharness Knowledge Export v1
description: A portable project-knowledge bundle. Since the local database became the single store, knowledge crosses machines only through a deliberate transfer like this one rather than by checking out a branch. Content is verified against its recorded digest on import, so an edited or truncated transfer is refused instead of being installed as project truth.

project_path.description: Provenance only. A bundle is importable into any project, because knowledge about how to work on a codebase is frequently worth carrying between checkouts of it.

selective.description: True when the bundle carries only chosen records. A selective bundle must never be accepted as a replace: it does not describe the records it omits, so its absences are not deletions.
